welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: :wave: [rainbow]¡Welcom[i]eEeEe!...[/i][/rainbow] Thanks for visiting my digital dumpster. This is my little corner of the web where I'll document every project I make in the future. Right now you are in the [u]Home[/u] page and there won't be anything special besides the latest entries and highlighted news, better browse around the site if you find something, if there even is anything. Remember to come back sometime in the future and always, always, [url=https://www.refreshyourcache.com/en/cache/]clear your browser cache[/url].

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description: [i][opacity=50][url=./assets/videos/about-me/3-fun-things-about-yourself.mp4]How do people introduce themselves without feeling awkward?[/url][/opacity][/i] [br][/br] Hey! I'm Timmy[opacity=50][u][i][tooltip=Originally a palindrome number. (123-6-321)](1236)[/opacity][/tooltip][/i][/u], a 20-year-old dude living in [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c5CQgsFJm0c]Uruguay[/url]. [br][/br][br][/br] I'm simply just another random [u][tooltip=Backend Software Developer... NEEEEERD]programmer[/tooltip][/u]. My hobbies are basically anything related to technology. Gaming, shows, movies, 3D modeling, game development, cybersecurity, [u][tooltip=Im not really deep enough into it to the point of having my own 24/7 server because of money reasons, but I would if I could. For now everything runs on my personal PC.]homelabbing(?)[/tooltip][/u]. I was always interested in [i]Art[/i], drawing and turning my creativity into something physical, but I never had the talent for those kinds of things, so I stayed with my computer typing letters until something magical appears.

website.description: My personal website hosted on Nekoweb, it will be my little corner of the internet where I'll keep every kind of project I've made or I'm currently developing. What you're seeing right now is one of the biggest public projects I have!

leafy.description: A simple Discord bot made with discord.js, nothing more, simple as that. You don't need external services or a complicated setup.
